descriptors.definition: Key audit matters are those of most significance in auditing the financial statements of the current period based on professional judgment. When no such matters exist, the auditor must explicitly state this within a designated paragraph.
inclusion: Matters of most significance in current period audit
Explicit reporting when no key audit matters exist
exclusion: Modified opinions under SA 705
Separate opinions on individual matters
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from modified opinions which directly alter the audit opinion rather than highlighting significant audit areas.

descriptors.concept_name: SA 705 Modifications To The Opinion In The Independent Auditor’S Report
descriptors.definition: This standard governs the auditor's responsibility to issue an appropriately modified report when financial statements are not free from material misstatement or when sufficient appropriate audit evidence cannot be obtained. The appropriate modification type depends on the nature of the matter and its pervasiveness.
inclusion: Qualified opinions due to material misstatement or scope limitation
Adverse opinions and disclaimers of opinion
exclusion: Unmodified audit reports
Emphasis of matter paragraphs addressing properly disclosed items
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from Emphasis of Matter paragraphs which do not alter the auditor's opinion.

descriptors.definition: Modified opinions comprise qualified opinions, adverse opinions, and disclaimers of opinion. Selection of the specific modification relies on whether underlying issues stem from material misstatements or potential evidence limitations, alongside the assessed pervasiveness across financial statements.
inclusion: Evaluation of misstatement nature
Assessment of evidence limitations and pervasiveness
exclusion: Unmodified standard opinions
Other reporting paragraphs without opinion modification
nearby_distinctions: Qualified opinions apply when effects are material but not pervasive, whereas adverse or disclaimer opinions apply when effects are both material and pervasive.

descriptors.definition: The auditor aims to clearly express an appropriately modified opinion when evidence indicates financial statements are materially misstated or when sufficient appropriate evidence is unobtainable. This ensures audit reports transparently convey significant deviations from financial reporting frameworks.
inclusion: Expressing clear modifications for material misstatements
Expressing modifications for inability to obtain sufficient evidence
exclusion: Issuing clean unmodified opinions when material errors persist
Expressing separate opinions on specific financial statement elements when an adverse opinion is issued overall
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from general reporting objectives by explicitly focusing on situations requiring opinion modification.

descriptors.concept_name: Circumstances When a Modification to the Auditor’s Opinion is Required
descriptors.definition: An auditor must modify the report opinion if financial statements contain material misstatements or if evidence limitations prevent verifying whether statements are free from material misstatements as a whole. These conditions trigger the evaluation of qualified, adverse, or disclaimer options.
inclusion: Situations with uncorrected material misstatements
Inability to gather sufficient appropriate audit evidence
exclusion: Audits with fully verifiable balances and unmodified reports
Matters resolved prior to audit completion
nearby_distinctions: Triggers mandatory modification rather than optional emphasis formatting.

descriptors.concept_name: Determining the Type of Modification to the Auditor’s Opinion
descriptors.definition: Qualified opinions are issued when misstatements or undetected potential effects are material but not pervasive to the financial statements. The determination requires weighing both the magnitude of the issue and its widespread impact across financial statement elements.
inclusion: Misstatements identified as material but non-pervasive
Potential effects from evidence limitations deemed material but non-pervasive
exclusion: Pervasive misstatements requiring adverse opinions
Pervasive scope limitations requiring disclaimers
nearby_distinctions: Differs from adverse opinions by restricting the impact to specific areas rather than pervading the entire financial statements.

descriptors.concept_name: Consequence of an Inability to Obtain Sufficient Appropriate Audit Evidence Due to a Management-Imposed Limitation after Engagement Acceptance
descriptors.definition: When management imposes scope limitations after engagement acceptance, the auditor must request removal and seek alternative procedures. If unresolved, the auditor qualifies the opinion for material effects or withdraws and disclaims if effects are pervasive and permitted by law.
inclusion: Communication with those charged with governance regarding limitations
Evaluating whether to qualify, withdraw, or disclaim
exclusion: Limitations imposed by circumstances outside management control
Scope limitations resolved via alternative audit procedures
nearby_distinctions: Specifically applies to post-acceptance management-imposed limitations rather than general evidence scarcity.

descriptors.concept_name: If the Auditor Decides to Withdraw
descriptors.definition: An auditor deciding to withdraw must communicate identified misstatements prompting opinion modifications to those charged with governance beforehand. Regulatory frameworks, such as SEBI guidelines, may restrict immediate resignation without issuing pending quarterly or annual review reports.
inclusion: Communication of misstatements prior to resignation
Compliance with mandatory reporting timelines before withdrawal
exclusion: Unrestricted resignations where regional listing agreements or regulations do not apply
Withdrawals executed without notifying governance bodies
nearby_distinctions: Integrates regulatory resignation constraints with standard audit withdrawal protocols.

descriptors.concept_name: Other Considerations Relating to an Adverse Opinion or Disclaimer of Opinion
descriptors.definition: Expressing an adverse opinion or disclaimer on financial statements as a whole prohibits including an unmodified opinion on individual financial elements under the same framework. Such contradictory reporting misleads users regarding the overall reliability of the financial statements.
inclusion: Prohibition of mixed unmodified element opinions alongside adverse whole opinions
Prohibition of mixed unmodified element opinions alongside disclaimers
exclusion: Issuing uniform modified reports across all components
Separate standalone reports governed by different frameworks where permitted
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from situations where qualified opinions allow partial specific reporting if it does not contradict the whole.

descriptors.concept_name: Form and Content of the Auditor’s Report When the Opinion is Modified
descriptors.definition: When modifying an opinion, the auditor must apply designated headings like Qualified Opinion and specify whether reporting under a fair presentation or compliance framework. Qualified reports must state that the opinion holds true except for the effects or possible effects of the described matters.
inclusion: Using specific section headings for modified opinions
Deploying except-for phrasing for material misstatements or evidence limitations
exclusion: Standard unqualified report wording
Omitting the basis for modification paragraph
nearby_distinctions: Differs from unmodified report styling by requiring explicit 'except for' phraseology linked to the basis section.

descriptors.concept_name: Communication with Those Charged with Governance
descriptors.definition: Prior to modifying an audit opinion, the auditor must discuss the underlying circumstances and proposed wording with those charged with governance. This ensures governance bodies are formally apprised of expected audit findings and misstatement classifications.
inclusion: Deliberating expected modifications with governance
Communicating circumstances and wording of modifications
exclusion: Unmodified audit reports lacking significant adjustments
Unilateral opinion filings without prior governance dialogue
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on pre-issuance governance dialogue rather than post-issuance report distribution.

descriptors.concept_name: SA 706 EMPHASIS OF MATTER PARAGRAPHS AND OTHER MATTER PARAGRAPHS IN THE INDEPENDENT AUDITOR’S REPORT
descriptors.definition: This standard guides the inclusion of additional paragraphs to draw users' attention to properly presented financial statement matters fundamental to user understanding or other relevant audit aspects. Emphasis of matter and other matter paragraphs clarify key disclosures without modifying the audit opinion.
inclusion: Emphasis of matter paragraphs for fundamental disclosures
Other matter paragraphs for audit responsibility context
exclusion: Matters requiring opinion modifications under SA 705
Matters designated as key audit matters under SA 701
nearby_distinctions: Differs from SA 705 modifications because the underlying matter is appropriately presented or disclosed without changing the opinion.
